crossRefs.note: The lords of the Philistines came up to her and said to her, “Entice him, and see in which his great strength lies, and…
When Solomon was old, his wives turned away his heart after other gods; and his heart was not perfect with Yahweh his…
Didn’t Solomon king of Israel sin by these things? Yet among many nations there was no king like him, and he was loved…
to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,
For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,
Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.
With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.
The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit. He who is under Yahweh’s wrath will fall into it.
I find more bitter than death the woman whose heart is snares and traps, whose hands are chains. Whoever pleases God…
The eye also of the adulterer waits for the twilight, saying, ‘No eye will see me.’ He disguises his face.
In the dark they dig through houses. They shut themselves up in the daytime. They don’t know the light.
They were as fed horses roaming at large. Everyone neighed after his neighbor’s wife.
They are all adulterers. They are burning like an oven that the baker stops stirring, from the kneading of the dough…

translations.web: “If my heart has been enticed to a woman, and I have laid wait at my neighbor’s door,
translations.bsb: If my heart has been enticed by my neighbor’s wife, or I have lurked at his door,
translations.kjv: If mine heart have been deceived by a woman, or if I have laid wait at my neighbour's door;
translations.asv: If my heart hath been enticed unto a woman, And I have laid wait at my neighbor's door;
